**Finding: deviation (medium) — § 19 Non-Solicitation of Employees (p0133)**

The clause binds us as well as Garman, and as drafted it is a **no-hire**, not a non-solicit: "both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party." Two playbook problems:

- **No-hire** language and coverage of **all employees** of the other party (not just those involved in the services) are walk-away items.
- No **general-advertising / unsolicited-approach carve-out**, so routine recruitment advertising would breach.

Duration (term + one year) is acceptable, and the clause is already mutual, so rather than striking it entirely (our preferred position) I took the fallback and narrowed it with a single replacement: solicitation only, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, plus carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. Redline validated (ok:true) against the approved precedent language.
